title: кімната in sentences
summary: The same forms in use. Read each sentence and choose the form that fits its gap: the words around it tell you the case and the number.

gen.sg.note: Genitive singular: немає takes the genitive.

dat.sg.sentenceGloss: Thanks to this room we have more space.

ins.sg.sentenceGloss: The kitchen is next to this room.

loc.sg.sentenceGloss: There is a window in this room.
loc.sg.note: Locative singular, after у for where something is.

gen.pl.sentenceGloss: There are five rooms in the flat.

dat.pl.sentenceGloss: Thanks to these rooms we have more space.

acc.pl.note: Accusative plural: the direct object, the same as the nominative for things.

ins.pl.sentenceGloss: The kitchen is between two rooms.

loc.pl.sentenceGloss: It is quiet in these rooms.
loc.pl.note: Locative plural, after у for where something is.
